title: Study in High Risk Patients Switched From Higher Doses of Other Statins to Crestor on the Percentage of Patients Reaching the New LDL-C Target Goal

sections.abstract: The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy of Crestor in high risk patients switched from higher doses of other statins in obtaining the new European Atherosclerosis Society (EAS) low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C) guidelines.
